challenger.en: Why not simply scale up GPU memory or rent a larger cluster to brute-force training throughput?

defense.en: Adding more compute GPUs does not solve a host CPU data-ingestion bottleneck—it only amplifies GPU idle time. By isolating format deserialization stalls and building an asynchronous pipeline, we unlocked ~10× throughput on existing hardware with zero added capex.
defense.zh-TW: 增加 GPU 算力無法解決主機端的資料載入阻塞，只會讓高價 GPU 閒置等待。透過定位格式反序列化瓶頸並建立非同步管線，我們在既有硬體上釋放約 10 倍訓練吞吐，達成零硬體增購支出。

challenger.en: Why use a deterministic hardware trigger sync bus instead of software network time protocol (PTP/IEEE 1588)?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼堅持設計硬體觸發同步匯流排，而不直接用軟體網路時間協定（PTP/IEEE 1588）？

defense.en: Software network polling introduces non-deterministic OS kernel scheduling jitter (100μs–1ms) on busy line controllers. At conveyor line speed, 500μs equals millimeter-level optical displacement, ruining 3D stereo calibration. Physical hardware sync lines guarantee sub-microsecond determinism.
defense.zh-TW: 軟體網路輪詢在產線控制器高負載時會引入非確定性的 OS 排程抖動（100μs–1ms）。在輸送帶運轉速度下，500μs 的時序差就等於毫米級的光學位移，摧毀 3D 立體標定精度。實體硬體同步線提供次微秒級確定性保證。

defense.zh-TW: 連續運轉 8 小時後，相機支架的熱脹冷縮導致立體基線外參矩陣微幅漂移。透過定義週期性自動標定靶標與熱補償調校規範解決。

challenger.en: Why build a custom TALK budget gate rather than simply letting an LLM agent summarize with max_tokens set in the API call?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼要自訂 TALK 預算閘門，而不是單純在 API 呼叫中設定 max_tokens 讓 LLM 自己總結？

defense.en: API max_tokens is a blunt truncation mechanism—it cuts output mid-sentence and doesn't prevent wasteful multi-agent recursive exploration upstream. The TALK gate evaluates the execution graph prior to dispatch, enforcing cognitive budgeting and deliberate synthesis routing before billing occurs.
defense.zh-TW: API 的 max_tokens 只是生硬的截斷機制——它會在句子中途切斷，且完全無法防止上游多 Agent 遞迴搜尋的 Token 浪費。TALK 閘門在派發前即評估執行圖預算，在計費產生前強制執行認知預算控管與精簡重導向。

defense.en: TALK 1.8 is an explicit formal cost model based on input token AST density and reasoning step weights, backed by verifiable JSON-LD receipts in the walkthrough artifact, explicitly scoped as calculated budget rather than wall-clock seconds.
defense.zh-TW: TALK 1.8 是基於輸入 Token AST 密度與推理步權重的形式化成本模型，在歷史流程展示中具備 JSON-LD 數位收據，並在邊界中嚴格界定為計算預算而非真人碼錶時間。

solution.en: Dual-track architecture: app-private scoped audio storage paired with non-destructive candidate diff review.
solution.zh-TW: 雙軌保真架構：應用程式私有沙盒原始音訊唯讀保護 ＋ 非破壞性候選修訂差分審閱。

boundary.en: Separates raw immutable audio from reviewable transcript cleanup under on-device processing.

en: Automatic, unreviewed in-place destructive text replacement

challenger.en: Why not let an automated AI pass directly rewrite the transcript into clean, polished prose in a single step?

defense.en: Single-pass automated rewriting is inherently destructive—it routinely drops technical jargon, precise numerals, or verbal nuances with legal/domain significance. Transcribe-for-X enforces a strict dual-track separation: the raw recording remains untouched ground truth, while cleanup suggestions are presented as granular visual diffs requiring explicit user acceptance.
defense.zh-TW: 單步自動改寫本質上具破壞性——容易抹除關鍵技術術語、精確數據或具備法律與領域意涵的語氣停頓。Transcribe-for-X 採用嚴格雙軌隔離架構：原始錄音作為唯讀真實基底，所有清理建議均以細粒度視覺差分呈現，需經使用者確認方可套用。

defense.en: Audio files are isolated within Android's app-private scoped storage sandbox, inaccessible to third-party applications. Core speech recognition runs via on-device models with zero network transmission, eliminating external data leakage.
defense.zh-TW: 音訊檔案嚴格隔離於 Android 應用程式私有沙盒儲存（Scoped Storage），第三方 App 無法存取；核心語音辨識全程於裝置端離線推論，無對外網路連線，從架構端杜絕資料外洩。
